concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-upi-flutter-drop-in]] — 2026-09-15 UPI Flutter Drop-in Sessions (Checkout v68+) and Advanced (`await`, Intent appId) add-on with TEST simulator instructions; Sessions URL, redirect-anchor and AUTHORISED/AUTHORISATION webhook wording differences are qualified in the source.
warnings: The Sessions integration-type row points to an Advanced-flow URL; the Sessions heading and create-session link retain Sessions scope.
The Advanced action row says action.type await while its URL anchor says handle-the-redirect; do not equate all UPI action types.

The checklist spells webhook eventCode AUTHORISED; the separately captured UPI API-only payment-result sections spell AUTHORISATION. Verify the event contract before relying on either checklist wording.
The QR simulator sentence is expressly '(on web)' and does not establish Flutter QR rendering or an actual final payment.
